onset.Description: Seconds from the first sample of the RAW streams of this run

Levels.ttl_up: rising edge on a digital input (CDIG_IN_x_Up)

value.Description: port: the port word (CPORT__1 row 2); ttl_up: the stored _Up sample number

source_channel.Description: Alpha Omega channel the event comes from

_note: port onsets = CPORT__1 timestamp / port clock rate - TimeBegin of the RAW streams (all Alpha Omega timestamps are on one clock). ttl_up onsets = CDIG_IN TimeBegin - RAW TimeBegin + (Up - 1) / digital rate; the first stored Up value is 1, i.e. the digital channel's TimeBegin is taken as the time of sample 1. The task code mapping of port words is in the behaviour files (sourcedata).
